heroHeadline: 100 Rebels Hand Over Arms in Colombia Peace Breakthrough
heroSubtitle: Colombian officials announced that 100 rebels handed over their arms in what authorities described as a new peace breakthrough, signaling continued progress in the Total Peace process amid the broader backdrop of the June 21 presidential runoff between Espriella and Cepeda.
footerNote: Data sourced from the Colombian Truth Commission (CEV), JEP, INDEPAZ, InSight Crime, ICRC, Human Rights Watch, UNODC, MOE (Electoral Observation Mission), Ecopetrol, and major international outlets.
